name: Zephyr Brisas BVE 36" Stainless Steel Wall Mounted Range Hood
shortDescription: The Brisas BVE wall-mounted range hood makes quite an impression. From its pro-style pyramid design to its 600-CFM internally installed motor, BVE is head and shoulders above the competition. Features an easy-to-install out-of-the-box design, high-grade stainless steel, precision metal folding for tight seams, LumiLight LED lighting, and electronic touch controls.

features.text: Electronic touch controls adjust the range hood blower and LED light levels, and enable the auto delay-off function.
Airflow Control Technology or ACT is an exclusive technology that gives installers the ability to set the maximum CFM levels to meet local code requirements.
LumiLight LED lights are eco-friendly and built to last with a lifetime of more than 25,000 hours.
High-quality, dishwasher-safe aluminum mesh filters for improved capture and performance.
The dual-level dimmable LEDs require less energy than traditional halogen lights, are cool to the touch, and provide uniform light distribution.
Ductless recirculating kit used when venting air outside your home is not possible. Smoke and odors pass through charcoal filters allowing purified air to be reintroduced into the kitchen.
Extension duct cover kit to accommodate ceiling heights up to 12 ft see spec sheets for more details.
